environment.config: identical to the Stage-1-v1 configuration (canonical C0 V2 + passive-harness defender w/o standby sync + v_s = 0)
environment.defender: stationary, zero velocity, never acts; ACTIVE under canonical swept interception (intercept_radius 2.5 m unchanged); interception terminates the episode
environment.defender_observation: canonical gate: flag/pos/vel features nonzero only when the TRUE 3-D attacker-defender range <= enemy_defender_detection_range (25 m); zeros otherwise
environment.initial_geometry: Stage-1 distribution: perimeter spawn, altitude U(10,30), initial heading offset U(0,90) deg off the line of sight

hypothesis: After expert initialization establishes reliable goal-directed pursuit, PPO can learn evasive deviations around a stationary interception threat without destroying the learned pursuit skill.

initialization.actor: matching Stage-1 BC checkpoint (mlp_extractor.policy_net + action_net + log_std = -2.0)
initialization.critic: FRESH, initialized by the PPO seed (value network of PPO(seed=seed))

mastery: two consecutive rollout validations pass ALL gate checks

placement.orientation: uniform angle about the local path tangent
placement.reference: noise-free canonical-A0 nominal path from the Stage-2 initial state (lambda along its arc length); amendment of the original initial-chord reference, approved by the user after the chord design gave A0 interception 51.5% < 70% (scenario_validation_initial_STOP.json, no training had started)
placement.stop_rule: A0 interception fraction < 0.7 on (149000, 149999) => STOP, do not tune after training starts
placement.validity: |x|,|y| <= L and 0 <= z <= max_altitude; invalid draws re-sampled (never clipped), <= 50 attempts

retention: anchor capture < 0.98 on 2 consecutive rollouts => PURSUIT RETENTION FAILURE (seed stops)
success_rule: >= 2/3 seeds master, mastered seeds retain Stage-1 pursuit, no shared pathology

validation.alternation: rollout k: odd -> A, even -> B
validation.final: 147000-147199 (200 episodes per seed) + matched canonical A0
